description: This Java class defines a Spring MVC controller (`ShopProductController`) handling HTTP requests related to product display, product details, and price calculations in an e-commerce web application. It includes methods for rendering product pages, calculating dynamic product prices based on attributes, and retrieving related products, utilizing several services and utilities for product management, caching, and presentation.

classes.name: ShopProductController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for handling product detail pages, related product retrieval, and dynamic pricing in an e-commerce application

methods.name: displayProductWithReference
methods.description: Handles requests to display product details with a reference to the calling page, using URL pattern with friendly URL and ref parameter.

methods.name: displayProduct
methods.description: Handles requests to display product details without a reference, based on the product's friendly URL.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to retrieve product by friendly URL, populate model with product details, attributes, reviews, related products, and prepare view template.

methods.name: calculatePrice
methods.description: AJAX endpoint to calculate product price dynamically based on selected attribute IDs.

methods.name: createAttribute
methods.description: Helper method to create an Attribute object from a ProductAttribute, localized to a specific language.

methods.name: relatedItems
methods.description: Retrieves related products for a given product, transforming them into ReadableProduct objects for display.
